# Third-Party Modified Version of the Fraunhofer QuaDRiGa

Version 2.6.1-0 experimental snapshot. Copyright and the complete original license are retained in `QuaDRiGa_License.txt` and the source files.

Modified distribution packaged by Boyu Teng on 2026-10-18: includes the experimental aggregate CDL channel adaptations (`equalization_new/Channel_CDL_TS_specific_v4.m`, `Channel_CDL_TS_specific_v5.m`) and omits unrelated experiment entry points. No numerical change was introduced to this snapshot during release packaging. Prior modification dates are not available. This directory is subject to the original noncommercial use conditions and must retain this notice and its full license.

Keep the directory name `quadriga_src`: this version uses it to locate scenario configuration files.
